messages.subject: Multi-species joint hurdle model
parts:
Hi there,

I am fitting spatio-temporal models for multi-species case using hurdle model. Do we have to consider ar1 models and spde models seperately for each species using replicate = sp or single funcion is enough?

Thank you in advance.

Muthu

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Multi-species joint hurdle model
parts:
there is not clear answer here, as the models

f(time...) + f(space)

is different from

f(time x space)

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Multi-species joint hurdle model
parts:
There is no objective answer to this. Depends on the details of the problem, what you want to do, and the data structure. Model comparison can be used between several models.
